title: IEEE Spectrum argues AI vulnerability discovery forces technical debt repayment
summary: An IEEE Spectrum article argues that AI-assisted vulnerability discovery is exposing decades of accumulated technical debt in software and forcing organizations to remediate it. The piece is an argument about software maintenance and security practice, not the announcement of a specific tool, version, or independently measured result, and the supplied material provides no remediation figures. It is aimed at software engineers and security teams facing a larger volume of vulnerability fixes.
